newsitem.title: USA: Sharper Image Aug same-store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Sharper Image Aug same-store sales fall.

text.p: Sharper Image Corp said Thursday that same store sales were $8.5 million, compared with $9.6 million for last August, which is a decrease of 12 percent.
The company said total sales for August was $12.0 million, a 13 percent decrease from total sales of $13.7 million for August 1995.

For the seven months of fiscal 1996, total company sales were $91.8 million, five percent lower than the $96.2 million for the same year-earlier period. Same stores sales decreased six percent to $61.3 million from $65.2 million.
